title: Asked to DM someone, Olisar sends it and reacts instead of replying

beats.speaker: rook
beats.text: olisar can you DM <@1089250623490359378> and let them know the arena run is finished

notes: The literal case the feature was asked for, and the only one that cannot be fully automated: Discord refuses bot-to-bot DMs, so the recipient has to be a human account — the operator's. The id is written into the beat because the people directory is built from who has posted in the channel, and the operator hasn't; without it Olisar has no id for the name and DMs the requester instead. The run asserts what it can see (a reaction here, no message here); whether the DM arrived is checked in the operator's own Discord. Tagged `manual` so a sweep doesn't DM a real person on every pass. The failure that matters is a reaction with no DM delivered — silence covering for an action that didn't happen — and the first run of this case produced its opposite: the DM failed with a 50007, acknowledge was refused, and Olisar said so in words.
